title: Bed Heal
description: Automatically restores players’ health and hunger when they wake up from bed. keeping you ready for adventure.
body:
This mod automatically restores your hunger and health when you wake up in bed.
No more worrying about being hungry or low on health after sleeping.
Make your survival more convenient and comfortable.

本模组会在你起床时，自动恢复饱食度与生命值。
睡觉后不再担心饥饿或残血，让你的生存更轻松、更舒适。
